notes.title: 0.2.2 beta branch available!
notes.content: [p]Hello testers! Thanks for bearing with us while we work on Patch #4.[/p][p][/p][p]There's currently an improved version of Patch #3 on the beta branch: beta_within_a_beta. If you haven't played Patch #3, you may wish to try this version as it should be far more stable and has numerous fixes and improvements. Please note that it won't be able to load your savegames from earlier versions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How to access the beta branch:[/b][/p][p]1. Right click Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned Playtest in your Steam Library and choose 'properties'.[/p][p]2. Go to 'Beta participation' and change 'None' to 'beta_within_a_beta'.[/p][p]3. Wait for the game to update. Play as normal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539563/18bd55fe2c60f2c4552b080a1e283f6e88ca9232.png"][/img][/p][p]Here are the patch notes - these changes (and more) will be rolled into Patch #4 when it lands.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Beta_within_a_beta Change List:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Moose's 'Constitution' trait has been replaced with 'Clout'. Attacks have a 20% chance to trigger a 'clout' attack, knocking enemies back slightly (it also makes a satisfying 'Slap!' sound).[/p][/*][*][p]The Moose's passive trait 'Tough as nails' has been implemented and tweaked slightly. It now gives him +6% max health (calculated after gear/passives/buffs, etc) and +2 AC.[/p][/*][*][p]New searching visuals. Press F to toggle search mode on and off.[/p][/*][*][p]Searching has been improved and rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now get surprised by entering combat while searching. It's still a work in progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to searching.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a variety of item management sounds (loot, equip, pick-up, place).[/p][/*][*][p]Active items (guns, thrown weapons, etc) now show the activation glow inside the backpack as well as the hotbar.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now split stacks of items by picking up an item stack and right clicking on a suitable inventory square.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment now flashes when equipped and plays a sound effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Items which fail to equip or activate (due to requirements) perform an error flash and sound effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Active item cooldowns now show inside the backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the trigger radius of the game's first combat encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the parallax background system and created some dev tools for quicker setup and alignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some bonus Shelby dialogue which can be accessed inside the mini-dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p]Shelby's directions on the whale map are now more accurate.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies may now carry (and use) healing potions.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now correctly equip and bind items they're given.[/p][/*][*][p]The lone Forgotten Whaler (beach) now carries a healing potion which he will drink at low health.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional enemies have been seeded with a chance to carry/use potions.[/p][/*][*][p]Casting a targeted offensive spell without a target will no longer cause an error message. Instead, characters will auto-target the nearest enemy and begin casting. A similar change has also been made for healing and support spells.[/p][/*][*][p]AI will now use health potions at 35% current health (was previously set to 50%).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the critical strike damage of Shadow Missiles and Namshub: Shadow (was set too high).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cooldown of Namshub: Frost by 1 second.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the starting health of all caged skeleton enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the level of Sea Urchins in the jail room by 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the level of Fly Spawners on the beach by 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the healing power of all health/rejuvenation potions.[/p][/*][*][p]The Trapper's Leap ability now launches her upwards slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Namshub: Shadow, Namshub: Frost, and Shadow Missiles can now backfire.[/p][/*][*][p]Offensive magic spells now have a difficulty rating. For each point placed in the attunement type of that spell (fire, shadow, water, etc) at a value higher than that spell's difficulty rating, its chance to backfire will be reduced by 1% (to a minimum of 1% chance to backfire).[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental traps now record being triggered when you change maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental traps are now tied to the save/load system.[/p][/*][*][p]Trap sounds now play at the correct volume and location.[/p][/*][*][p]Added mini health-bar functionality for friendly characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini health-bar visuals have received some polish.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the mouseover information for spells and abilities which are bound to the hotbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy status effects are now visible and can be found on the target bar (top of screen).[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the trap system.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the inventory system (item allocation, sound, cooldowns).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a targeting bug linked to Taunt (AI range-finding error).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a targeting bug linked to loot objects (GUI lock error).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a memory leak which was causing the game to crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash which occurred when shockwaves encountered downed players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed yet another Shelby intro cutscene crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by Insect Clouds not belonging to any faction.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a developer debug which was accidentally shipped with Patch #3 (pressing 'G' dropped all living investigators' health to 1).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which caused Shelby to crash the game when you turned down his offer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which prevented magical projectiles from backfiring.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which caused Shadow Missiles to immediately hit the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which was causing levers to reset on room change.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation error caused by dashing into bear traps.[/p][/*][*][p]Evasion abilities now correctly evade magical projectiles and thrown harpoons.[/p][/*][*][p]Drinking a Potion of Evasion no longer causes the game to crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleared skeleton cages no longer appear to reset when backtracking to the jail room.[/p][/*][*][p]The placeholder rest function (shortcut: R) now correctly restores stamina and mana points.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can no longer softlock the game by leaving the portal room (sewers) before clearing the portal.[/p][/*][*][p]The game no longer crashes when you speak with Shelby inside the mini-dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can no longer get knocked out of bounds by Mor'baz's Ground Pound attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue with item requirement checks. This was also preventing the Scribe from equipping items.[/p][/*][*][p]Saving the game now correctly records ability attunement scores.[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory SFX: Added many item management/looting sounds. Not all of these are correctly linked to items at this time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some errors on the tooltips of Namshub: Frost, Shadow Missiles, Dash, and Shuffle.[/p][/*][*][p]SFX: Improved the sound effect timing of various melee attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Potion Drink (Standard).[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Potion Drink (Magical).[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Spell backfire.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Steam Cloud is now enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]And more! Patch notes for Patch #4 will be comprehensive (and categorized).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Backer Test Patch #3 is Live!
notes.content: [p]We're back with Playtest Patch #3. First of all, apologies to those of you who have been experiencing the various cutscene errors and crashes. We've altered how the cutscenes function behind the scenes, and that should hopefully resolve most of the issues. We are still aware of a rare cutscene crash linked to the interface, but if you still experience regular, repeating crashes, be sure to let us know on the message boards![/p][p][/p][p][b]Cutscene crashes and errors:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The scripts which govern the cutscene system have been improved and future-proofed. This should reduce/eliminate the frequent crashes which have been happening during story events.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Investigators:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Scribe is now playable. *[/p][/*][*][p]The Innkeeper's 'Lightning Strikes' passive is now working correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]* Note: He's still missing some of his unique abilities and traits.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Taunts, threat and tanking:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added functionality for taunt-style abilities and effects (taunts force the target, if controlled by AI, to attack the caster).[/p][/*][*][p]Added some 'taunt logic' to AI. When deciding who to taunt, followers will prefer to cast it on targets who are attacking ranged or spellcaster allies.[/p][/*][*][p]There's now a basic system in place for generating threat, a hidden resource which determines how enemies choose their targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee attacks generate slightly more threat than ranged attacks and spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Added functionality for dropping/reducing one's threat, as well as threat multipliers through gear or status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Evasion Abilities (see below) will usually reduce a character's threat when used.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Party screen and character creation:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Characters can now learn abilities and bring them into a new game. Note that a large number of abilities haven't been implemented yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities you can't learn now perform an error 'rattle' and sound effect when clicked.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking the talent text in the bottom-right window now opens the talents tab.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Abilities:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game's various ability menus now function correctly. Abilities can be found in the Abilities tab \[default key: N] and dragged to the hotbar. To avoid confusion, switching to a different character's ability list will also switch the player to control of that character.[/p][/*][*][p]Namshub: Flame, Frost and Shadow have new icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Namshub: Flame now applies a damage over time effect.[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Namshub: Frost.[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Namshub: Shadow.[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Shadow Missiles.[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Taunt.[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Restore.[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Backstab (Passive).[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Mark Target (Trapper exclusive).[/p][/*][*][p]New ability: Pummel (Innkeeper exclusive).[/p][/*][*][p]We've added a simple 'ability priority' system which should help the AI make more intelligent decisions about which spells and abilities to use and when. As before, investigators controlled by AI will only use abilities and items which are bound to their hotbar.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to these changes, we've standardised a vast number of systems governing ability creation, learning and use. This means that adding new spells and abilities moving forward should be simpler and quicker.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Evasion abilities:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each investigator now has an Evasion Ability (with the exception of the Moose). Activate to perform an evasive manoeuvre (dash, roll, etc) and gain massive evasion from direct attacks (100% chance to evade) for 2 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]The Innkeeper and Gentleman's evasion ability, Dash, is now working as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]New evasion ability: Strafe (Bard, PI).[/p][/*][*][p]New evasion ability: Shuffle (Scribe, Curator).[/p][/*][*][p]New evasion ability: Leap (Trapper). Note that the 'leap' effect (forced jump) isn't in yet.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Status effects:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New particle system for status effects! Multiple buffs and debuffs can now be visible on a target (burning, bleeding, etc) at once.[/p][/*][*][p]New status effect: Burning.[/p][/*][*][p]New status effect: Chilled.[/p][/*][*][p]New status effect: Restore.[/p][/*][*][p]New status effect: Hunter's Mark (Mark Target).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Story:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added some additional dialogue when asking Shelby for directions in the sewers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Combat:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can now target allies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra colors to the scrolling damage numbers to reflect the different elemental damage types.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blocked damage will no longer reduce a character's health below 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some initial recoil when aiming firearms to counter 'snap-firing'.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the maximum health of all enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Ability menu has been moved out of the character pane and now has its own window (shortcut: N).[/p][/*][*][p]The character portraits have been given another pass and a minor style update.[/p][/*][*][p]New UI elements for targeting allies (green health bars, etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Status effects now tell you how many seconds are remaining on them when you mouseover their icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities tell you how long is left on the cooldown when mouse-overed (if applicable).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Misc:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New SFX: Frost spell casting and successful cast sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Water spell casting and successful cast sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Shadow spell casting and successful cast sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Namshub: Frost hit.[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Namshub: Shadow hit.[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Mark Target.[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX: Restore (Ability) heal sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Scrolling combat text is shorter and current tense (changed 'missed' to 'miss', 'evaded' to 'evade', etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sound code to handle spells and spell casting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Optimization, bugfixes and crashes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a dialogue crash when talking to Shelby inside the sewers 'blockage' encounter room.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some instances of outdated item drops which were causing errors/crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which caused characters to snap to the nearest ground tile mid-jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation error which caused characters to fall over.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor thrown and firearm animation errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare firearm crash (evade skill check).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error with the reporting of scrolling damage and healing numbers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error in the sound code which was preventing environmental sounds (ocean, rain, etc) looping correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare targeting error which occurred when running multiples of the same investigator.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Backer Test Patch #2 is Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Tea Party of the Damned Playtest - now on Steam! This test is only available to backers who pledged the Town Council tier (or higher), but we'll soon be rolling it out to other backers once more features are in place.

Here are the changes in patch #2:

[b]Atmospheric/Tactical camera:[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera changes - The game is now in 'Atmospheric mode' by default. This is more zoomed in than past builds, however the camera zooms out when you look/aim at a distance. We feel this makes the game less frantic, plus you can see more of that pretty pixel art!

[i]Note: In atmospheric mode, the game will also zoom out during tactical pause (coming in a future patch). Also there's currently no option to swap back to tactical mode, but we'll add it when we fill out the options screen.[/i][/list]
[b]Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*] New enemy: Forgotten Whaler. Watch out for the harpoon!
[*] New enemy: Jailer Mor'baz.
[*] Skeletons now correctly cycle between one of three running animations.
[*] Non-roaming Skeletons have new idle animations (sitting, etc).
[/list]
[b]Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've temporarily given the Innkeeper a Tommy gun.
[*] Some melee, thrown and ranged weapon skills now rank up in combat. Higher skill ranks = a higher chance to hit with that weapon type.
[*] Improvements made to 'Quickfire' mode (LMB). No longer triggers the 'look' action, and now has a cooldown to prevent spam-clicking.
[*] You can now target/un-target enemies while aiming.
[*] Blocking is in the game! Characters with the skill can now block melee attacks on themselves and nearby allies, redirecting the damage to themselves and reducing it by 25%. Equipping a shield item will reduce blocked damage by an extra 25%. Only one shield can be equipped at a time.
[*] AI-controlled characters will no longer use potions out of combat.
[*] Potion code has been greatly improved and future-proofed. Healing potions can critically heal.
[*] Status effects and equipment can temporarily unlock defensive abilities (Evade Potions grant access to the Evade skill for their duration, etc).
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies can vary in level, and their stats and skills scale to match.
[*] Slightly reduced the accuracy of all attacks and weapons.
[*] Reduced several characters' access to Evasion. This should make spellcaster type characters, as well as static enemies (like the spawners) easier to hit.
[*] Tougher enemies now have AC (armor class), slightly reducing the damage of physical attacks made against them. 1 point of AC = roughly 1% to 2% damage reduced. Armor Class is capped at AC 50 and starts to drop in value at numbers higher than 20.
[*] Damage resistances slightly reworked - it's now percentage based, rather than in tiered brackets.
[/list]
[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mini-dungeon challenge! In order to beat the sewers, you must clear 5 rooms of a mini-dungeon. If you wipe you will not lose your progress but instead be transported back to the safe room with your HP/MP/STAM restored. *
[*] Extra level added to the sewers (entrance to mini-dungeon).
[*] Sewer exit room redesigned.
[*] Loot containers added to the following areas: Sewers Safe Room, Whale Interior (beach 3), Sewer Pipe Gauntlet.
[*] New hazard: Acrid Seawater.
[*] New hazard: Rushing Water.

[i]* Note: Mini-dungeon rooms and encounters are currently linear, but they will include procedural generation in the future.[/i][/list]
[b]Story:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new cutscenes added to the sewers.
[*] Tweaked the timings and trigger proximity of the first Shelby cutscene.
[*] Added a 'Shelby wants to speak with you' trigger, which prompts the player to use their Shelby item at moments where he has something to say.
[*] Added several more dialogue outcomes to speaking with Shelby from backpack, in particular when asking him for directions.
[/list]
[b]Items & Looting:
[/b][list]
[*] Several new loot objects added to the beach and sewers.
[*] Starter items have new tooltips/descriptions.
[*] New item 'Worn Shooting Gloves' added to the Beach starter chest.
[*] New item 'Driftwood Shield' added to the Beach starter chest.
[*] New item 'Leather Undershirt'.
[*] New item 'Wretched Sealskin Cloak'.
[*] New item 'Acolyte's Hood'.
[*] New item 'Potion of Evasion'.
[*] New item 'Tainted Rejuvenation Potion'. Smells like rotten eggs. Perhaps the Alchemist can do something with these when she's added to the game.
[*] New item 'Broken Spectacles'.
[*] New item 'Chicago Typewriter'.
[/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tooltip info for 'Armor Class' in the character pane.
[/list]
[b]Party screen and Character Creation:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of extra mouseovers, UI sounds and tooltips!
[*] 'Auto Party' renamed 'Reset Party'. Game now asks for confirmation when resetting/clearing non-premade characters.
[*] Trapper 'Marksmanship' (rifle upgrade) skill renamed 'Gunsmithing'.
[/list]
[b]Minor changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made improvements to the music code. Minor enemies should no longer trigger combat music.
[*] Entering a cutscene will now clear your current target.
[*] New SFX for waterfalls, levers, cages, being stunned and more!
[*] Created a universal system for shockwaves (used in spells and abilities).
[*] Added version checking, mostly to warn players who are trying to load savegames from outdated game versions.
[*] Added several new message log notifications.
[*] More physics objects (tin cans, bottles) have been placed around the sewer and beach levels.
[/list]
[b]Optimization, bugfixes and crashes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer target friendly AI after taking friendly fire.
[*] Fixed some instances of the cutscene crash (level_switch variant).
[*] Optimised friendly and enemy AI (agro radius, status effects, stat checks).
[*] Fixed some resolution/UI issues on 16:10 monitors.
[*] Fixed a slowdown which occurred when looking/aiming over long periods.
[*] Fixed some issues with aiming firearms and weapon swapping, including one bug where you could softlock the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies were regenerating HP in combat.
[*] Fixed a crash involving the Shelby backpack cutscene on Beach 01.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy Patch #2. Be sure to send us your feedback and bug reports via discord or email!
